decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - GRANT
Reasons:
The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 14th February 2006, the erection of a single storey rear extension measuring 3.0m x 2.75m x 3.45m, plus 3.0m x 0.8m x 1.75m, with a glazed pitched rooflight section measuring 1.8m x 1.5m x 0.8m, and an attached canopy structure measuring 0.75m x 4.3m x 0.2m, plus 1.75m x 0.75m x 0.2m, and the erection of a single storey side extension measuring 2.46m (average height) x 1.05 x 2.9m, as shown on drawings 271-01, 03, S01 and S02, received 14th February 2006, and drawing 271-02A, received 02nd March 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the proposed extensions plus existing extensions are of a volume, dimension and location allowable under this order.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the demolition of existing rear outbuilding and ground floor side extension and the erection of a single storey side extension and single storey rear extension to house.
